venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Crisp autumn evening, beautiful weather all day
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 9/26 (MOD MKZ/JK; crisp autumn evening, beautiful weather all day).** Net sales $8,650 vs target $9,605 (-9.9%). Food $342. Comps $62. 293 guests, check avg $29.52. Slower start to the night, but volume picked up around 9:30pm and stayed high until about 12:30am; DJ kept energy up with classic throwbacks. Kitchen pushed food out in a timely manner and supported front of house during the rush — some of the pop may have come from the Oktoberfest beltline crawl passing by. Low on Tanqueray. No incidents; no-shows not charged (none). Favorite moment: a bride and her bridesmaids enjoying the mini martinis, delighted by the novelty of the tiny glass. Entered by Daniel. (Note: form's typed date read 2026-04-03, a clear typo; day-of-week 'Saturday' and post time 3:27am ET 9/27 place this on 9/26.)

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 9/26 (MOD/Chef KE/DJ; nice weather).** Net sales $8,625 vs target $12,110 (-28.8%). Food $348. Comps $107 (1.24%). 309 guests, check avg $27.91. A definitely slower Saturday — team suspects the nice weather kept people elsewhere. Never got the normal pop; the push that did come didn't arrive in full swing until close to midnight. A handful of regulars in, and a good crowd dancing despite the slower night — folks who didn't necessarily know each other bonding over the music. Kitchen smooth sailing. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: a whole crowd of strangers dancing together. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 9/26 (AM MOD Maggie H; PM MOD Carey & Lucas).** Net sales incl. events $27,592.19 vs target $17,365 (+58.9%). Food incl. events $9,475.50. Event net sales $10,482 (event food $5,860). DC/AM sales $1,652.22; D&C (PM) $15,457.97. Comps $638.27 (3.81%). 424 guests (Tock). AM: smooth day with Felix de Rosa + Cara Leite, one IRD and a cocktail pop late in the day; wedding party stopping by for drinks between setup, Ramble lobby bumping by close. PM: short-handed again (down a server, support, and host — fall sickness going around) but the team pushed through with running, bussing, restocking and guest-touching all night, landing in the mid-400s for guests versus the normal high-300s. Kitchen busy with Rand and Ayu on sauté, Chefs Rachel and Lucas handling the event. Held a wedding ceremony/reception for Caroline & Grace, 43 guests, 5-10pm in the Garden and Vauxhall — oyster bar and buffet dinner, perfect autumn weather, wedding planner thanked the team; September weddings wrapped for the season. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: no table touches for unhappy guests despite being short-handed. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 9/26 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Will; overblown but constant rain).** Net sales (incl. events) $7,196 vs target $7,544 (-4.6%). Food $654, Beverage $6,542. Comps $228.57. 205 guests, check avg $35. A decent open with reasonable waves periodically crimped by campers (some likely avoiding the storm, some day-drinkers not ready to head home), a big fallow stretch 11pm-12:30am, and a few rambunctious parties in the final hour — 7 large parties, 2 solos, 1 investor cocktail. Top sellers: Native Lion, Eight Limb Daiquiri, Tripwire. Door: finally got a taste of the incoming storm; didn't get too crazy until last seating, with a large 6pm push and a 9:30pm push. Checks took longer to move once dropped because of the weather; large parties of 6-8 around 12:30am kept floor energy up. 3 no-shows. Kitchen: strong first push. Glassware: 1 pilsner, 1 N&N, 1 dof broken. One bathroom being repaired, making large parties tougher at the start/end of service. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Nice toasty day and warm night.
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 9/26 (MOD/Chef Julian, Gianna and Josh; toasty day, warm night).** Net sales $14,529 vs target $13,222 (+9.9%). Food $2,972 (Standing Room sales $3,556/food $668; Marquee sales $10,950/food $2,282). Comps $310.66. 349 guests, check avg $41.63. Busy from the jump with a full house early and a skeleton crew that still managed to kill service; stayed persistent all night, felt like it never let up, with tons of large parties in both rooms. Regular Jeffrey brought a handful of friends to the standing room; some investors stopped by along with birthdays and first dates — a genuinely busy shift that kept everyone on their toes, with the team getting credit for it. Kitchen: two-man crew for a busy shift, Angel up to date. A phone was lost and not found (info in lost & found); restroom needs a paint touch-up. 86'd Aperol and Botanist. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 9/26 (Shift MOD Josh/Jesse; rainy day).** Net sales incl. events $11,134.61 vs target $9,635 (+15.6%). Marquee bar $8,608.41, Garden $2,739.78 (total sales $11,290.41). Food $1,319. Comps $155.80, voids $61.20. 201 guests. Garden started slow, then picked up significantly around 7:45pm and stayed strong through last call, with a steady flow of larger groups keeping Jada busy and Jesse floating to support; team suggests scheduling a second Garden bartender on nights with this level of traffic to avoid a bottleneck. Marquee picked up around 8:15pm with a mix of 2/3-tops and larger groups sheltering from the rain, ordering multiple rounds; pacing solid with a few moments where seating/check-dropping could've been more proactive. Kitchen busy, James crushing it solo — bread/butter, cheese plate and cookies the standouts, though chicken prep time is stretching ticket times and may need adjustment. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the team challenge to sell 'Carroll Gardens'. Entered by Josh. (Note: form's typed date read 9/27, a likely typo; day-of-week 'Saturday' and post time 5:31am ET 9/27 place this on 9/26.)

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 9/26 (AM MOD Justin & Lex/Shannon; PM MOD Justin & Shannon/Drew; nice temperate and sunny day).** Net sales $13,287 vs target $13,131 (+1.2%). Food $4,488. Comps $305. Guests: 88 morning + 194 evening (OpenTable) = 282, check avg $47.12. Municipal Bar morning sales $2,514, evening $7,093; Sun Club $736; Hot Eye $2,945. Morning: a few guests right at 8am, slow build to just a few tables at a time until noon; biggest push ended up being at 11am, three servers cut to two shortly after 1pm; no bartender until 1pm. Evening: easy, steady pace that didn't feel like weekend action until 7pm; same reservation volume as the prior night but fewer walk-ins; third well shut down at 8:30pm, two bartenders handled the rest comfortably. Sun Club: good day, perfect weather, guests mostly napped poolside. Hot Eye: steady but not busy start, filled with industry and locals by 9pm, then a huge wedding party packed the room by 10pm — slammed until about 11:45pm. No incidents. Maintenance: bar Crysali down, waiting on parts. Favorite moment: a 23rd birthday that turned into a cake fight, Estella Reyes solo SA-ing through the end of the night, and Hot Eye packed wall to wall. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 9/26 (MOD Curtis Hayes/Julian Abel; great weather).** Net sales $6,955 vs target $10,000 (-30.5%). Food $924. Event sales $5,000. Comps $751 total (~$150 in shifties) — elevated due to reservations being smashed up and a number of service recoveries. ~200 guests including the buyout (guest count given as an approximation; check avg not reported). First buyout of the venue's run went smoothly — flipped the house expertly, tab voided (team wasn't certain whether to void or comp it). A little wonky getting all reservations reseated after the flip but Curtis Hayes worked his magic and got everyone comfortable. Kitchen: Sfian and Josh killed it, event party very happy with the food; sold more white wine in the event than probably every other day combined. Maintenance: freezer well 100, foot pedals for 2nd sink. Low on Uwajima gimlet for tomorrow's service. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Gianni on the door with Malachi. Entered by Julian Abel.
